create_OPTConfig_default: create an OPTConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the facebook/opt-350m model
create_OPTConfig_custom: create an OPTConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
create_OPTConfig_init_proj: create an OPTConfig instance with word_embed_proj_dim set to down-project word embeddings
create_OPTConfig_bias_norm: create an OPTConfig instance with enable_bias and layer_norm_elementwise_affine disabled
summarize_OPTConfig: summarize the OPTConfig class and its configurable model parameters
